stories.title: No. 9 Ole Miss squeaks by Louisville on late FG
stories.summary: Lucas Carneiro kicked a 48-yard field goal as time expired to give ninth-ranked Mississippi a 41-38 victory over No. 24 Louisville on Sunday night.

stories.title: No. 4 Irish pull away, down Badgers at Lambeau
stories.summary: CJ Carr threw two touchdown passes, Aneyas Williams ran for 90 yards and two more scores, and No. 4 Notre Dame pulled away in the second half to beat Wisconsin 41-13 on Sunday night at Lambeau Field.

stories.title: Shanahan changes tune on Aussie trip: It's right
stories.summary: Having been here since early Friday morning, Kyle Shanahan's concerns about taking part in the NFL's first regular-season game in Australia have dissipated.

stories.title: WMU prez: B1G's replay process could improve
stories.summary: Western Michigan president Russ Kavalhuna told ESPN that he didn't think the Big Ten's replay process that put a second back on the clock, leading to Michigan's winning touchdown pass over the Broncos, "is as good as it could be."

stories.title: Shelton coasts as U.S. puts 3 into men's quarters
stories.summary: Frances Tiafoe and Alex Michelsen are headed to the US Open quarterfinals, and Ben Shelton joined them with a victory late Sunday night, as American men are taking a real run at ending a lengthy Grand Slam drought that dates to 2003.
